reading.title: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
reading.summary: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

news.title: Burnham gambles on radical progressive plan to help Britain ‘rise again’
news.summary: PM accepts some of his plan could be difficult and admits he ‘may pay a political price’ Analysis: PM’s promises will take time to come good Key takeaways from Burnham’s conference speech Andy Burnham has staked his future on a gamble that the public will back radical progressive policies on social care, electoral reform and Europe, telling voters that his agenda will break the mould of the last 40 years and “allow us to rise again”. In a deeply personal speech at Labour’s conference, Burnham began building his next general election manifesto, acknowledging that he may end up paying the price for creating sharp new dividing lines in politics.
